content.title: How I Advanced My Security Consultant Career with IBM
content.text: How I Advanced My Security Consultant Career with IBM Subo Wijeyesinghe is a Senior Security Consultant within IBM Consulting’s Cyber Strategy & Risk team. With more than 10 years at IBM, he supports organisations in designing secure, resilient, and compliant digital environments. His work spans critical infrastructure, government, financial services, and utilities. Through complex security and cloud engagements, Subo helps clients manage risk while enabling transformation. His journey reflects IBM’s focus on deep expertise, innovation, and continuous learning. What team are you currently part of? I am part of the Cyber Strategy & Risk team within IBM Consulting. How has IBM supported your professional development? Although I joined IBM 10 years ago as an experienced cybersecurity consultant and architect, IBM has played a key role in further shaping and polishing my professional journey. From access to world-class training resources and certifications to opportunities to collaborate with diverse, talented teams on both local and global projects, every experience has added meaningful value to my growth. IBM’s culture of continuous learning, innovation, and mentorship has helped me deepen my technical expertise and consulting capabilities, while constantly encouraging me to challenge myself and think bigger. I am truly grateful to be part of a workplace that continuously invests in its people. What projects have you worked on since joining IBM? Over the past 10 years, I have had the opportunity to work on a wide range of impactful projects across critical infrastructure, government, financial services, utilities, education, transportation, mining, and leisure sectors. While the list is long, some key highlights include conducting in‑depth security assessments across the SOC, ERP platform, and hybrid enterprise cloud environment as a Senior Security Architect, leading complex security architecture assessments across multiple domains, including critical infrastructure, leading and delivering a DevSecOps assessment, framework, and strategy as a Senior Security Consultant, contributing to digital transformation to leading a maturity assessment against the NIST Cybersecurity Framework, followed by developing an end‑to‑end corporate cybersecurity strategy and many others projects. Each engagement has strengthened my expertise across security architecture, compliance, cloud security, and cybersecurity strategy, while helping clients navigate increasingly complex challenges. What was your initial impression of IBM’s work culture? My initial impression of IBM’s work culture was very positive. The environment is collaborative and supportive, with a knowledgeable and diverse team that is always willing to share insights and help each other grow. There is a strong emphasis on continuous learning and innovation, which motivates us to challenge ourselves and stay ahead in this fast-evolving industry. Overall, it felt like a place where I could contribute meaningfully while continuing to develop professionally. What specific skills have you gained while working at IBM? During my time at IBM, I have further polished a broad range of skills across both technical and consulting domains. Keys among them are: Security architecture for complex enterprise and hybrid cloud environmentsExpertise in AI-driven security solutions and integrating AI to enhance threat detection and responseDeep knowledge of compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST, and ISM/IRAPHands‑on cloud security experience, especially across Azure and AWS platformsDevelopment and implementation of DevSecOps strategiesCybersecurity strategy and risk managementStrong project leadership, guiding cross-functional teams to successful deliveryProficiency in Agile methodologies and IBM Garage practices to drive innovationEffective stakeholder management and translating technical concepts into clear business value IBM’s focus on continuous learning and exposure to cutting-edge technologies has played a major role in sharpening these skills. Discover your potential at IBM Subo’s experience at IBM highlights how meaningful work, trusted clients, and ongoing development come together. From leading security architecture initiatives to shaping enterprise cybersecurity strategies, his career demonstrates the impact IBMers can make at scale. IBM’s collaborative culture and investment in people continue to support his growth as a consultant and leader. If you’re passionate about cybersecurity and solving complex challenges, IBM Consulting offers the opportunity to grow and lead.
